correctness.rationale: The two initial laws are distinct. With v the indicator of unprotected sites, 1^T K = μ v^T proves the unprotected mean n/[μ(n−2)], the stated variance identity, and L_d(s)=1−ns/[μ(n−2)]+s² Z_d(s)/[μ(n−2)] for Z_d(s)=1^T(K_d+sI)^{-1}1. The two-refuge correction to an everywhere-killed cycle gives Z_d(s)=n/a+2μ/{a²[1−μ(G_s(0)+G_s(d))]}, a=μ+s. Positivity of the denominator follows by conjugating K_d+sI by B_s^{-1/2}, with B_s=aI−Q, and comparing the nonzero eigenvalues of B_s^{-1/2}UU^TB_s^{-1/2} and U^TB_s^{-1}U. Periodizing the infinite-line decaying kernel gives the displayed cosh Green function, which strictly decreases over 1 through floor(n/2), including the even and odd endpoints. Thus the transforms, variances, and all-site means have the claimed strict direction. An independent hand solve of Kt=1, Km_2=2t, and (K+I)u=1 on C_4 at γ=μ=1 gives unprotected means (2,2), variances (6,5), L(1)=(2/5,3/8), and all-site means (5/2,9/4), in order of increasing separation. This bounded check is distinct from the frozen verifier’s 138 recorded comparisons.

value.rationale: The exact mean is insensitive to refuge spacing under a natural starting ensemble, yet all positive Laplace parameters distinguish the placements in the same strict direction, for every cycle and both rates. This is an exact risk comparison not obtainable from the mean and clarifies why averaging over all sites instead changes the mean comparison. It does not amount to stochastic dominance or a management recommendation.
